population.entity.name: unique unordered city pair, identified by standardized city names: lexicographically smaller city name as city1, larger as city2

population.eligibility.value: every distinct city pair that appears in at least one flight between the two cities; a pair is defined over two different cities, so a flight whose departure and arrival airports belong to the same city does not create a pair
population.eligibility.rationale: 题面说 'all the unique city pairs'，business-definitions 用城市名标准化定义唯一城市对（对称性），隐含两个不同城市；同城不构成城市对。

population.source.note: flights 提供 departure_airport/arrival_airport；airports_data 提供 city(jsonb) 与 coordinates(point)；距离由 coordinates 现算

population.joinMultiplicity.value: 每个 flight 分别连接 airports_data 两次（出发、到达），各取一行，1:1，不产生重复计数

of.of: route_distance_km (Haversine over airports_data.coordinates of the flight's departure and arrival airports)

measure.countGrain.value: count of city pairs (entities), not flights

measure.denominator.value: denominator of the per-city-pair average is the number of flights between that city pair

cite.quote: the average distance for each city pair is calculated by summing the distances and dividing by the total number of flights between those cities
